# openski.org

> Free ski piste maps for about 3,900 ski areas worldwide from OpenStreetMap, with hour-by-hour piste
> conditions and routes for skis and snowboards everywhere, live lift status at about 180 resorts, and lift
> queues counted from webcams at a few. No account, no install; download a resort to use it offline.

openski.org is built on OpenStreetMap and OpenSkiMap data. Mappers can fix lifts and pistes from the app;
their changes go to OpenStreetMap under their own account.

## Pages

- [Ski areas](https://openski.org/resorts): search every ski area by name
- Resort map: `https://openski.org/<resort-id>`, e.g. [Sölden](https://openski.org/soelden)
- Conditions and lift queues now: `https://openski.org/<resort-id>/now`
- Route planner: `https://openski.org/<resort-id>/route`
- Ski area facts (piste km by colour, lifts, heights, piste maps): `https://openski.org/<resort-id>/about`
- Link to one piste or lift on the map: `https://openski.org/<resort-id>?piste=<id>` or `?lift=<id>`
- All resort pages: [sitemap](https://openski.org/sitemap.xml)

## What the numbers mean

- Piste conditions are estimates (0 = poor, 100 = great) from the Open-Meteo forecast, the sun and the
  terrain; they do not know what was groomed.
- Lift status comes from each resort's live status feed, credited on screen; lifts the feed does not name
  are shown as unknown.
- Queue counts are people counted on the resort's public webcams in the browser; each count links to the
  picture it was made from.

## Data and licences

- Map data: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), via OpenSkiMap
- Weather: Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0)
- Webcams, lift status and piste maps belong to their providers and are linked wherever they show
